verdict.rationale: Gram is an AI control-plane platform with a CLI, so a telemetry opt-out is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence pack has no documented opt-out from vendor telemetry or usage tracking. The only telemetry mention, "configure telemetry delivery," is about routing org observability data to destinations, not opting out of collection. The product is built around tracking tool calls and usage rather than letting users decline it.
